name: ads-plane
description: Read-only observer and control-plane foundation for AI Development Standard projects

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @ads-plane/contracts && npm run build -w @ads-plane/reducer && npm run build -w @ads-plane/github-adapter && npm run build -w @ads-plane/storage
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @ads-plane/server && npm run build -w @ads-plane/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @ads-plane/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @ads-plane/reducer && npm run typecheck -w @ads-plane/github-adapter && npm run typecheck -w @ads-plane/storage && npm run typecheck -w @ads-plane/server && npm run typecheck -w @ads-plane/web
scripts.check: npm run build && npm test && npm run typecheck
